titulo_fr: Une petite annonce : Observer les formes
titulo_es: A classified ad: Vocabulary and shapes
intro: Search for price, features and conditions in a simple ad. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: Search for price, features and conditions in a simple ad. Find first names, days, places and figures: in notices and chips they are usually easy to locate.
Attention point: The adjectives and the quantities describe the object; « à vendre » points to a sale. In this fragment, «vélo» means «bicycle».

frases.fr: Le vélo est disponible à Tours pour quarante euros.
frases.es: La bicicleta está disponible en Tours por cuarenta euros.
frases.en: The bike is available in Tours for 40 euros.

frases.fr: Le vendeur donne aussi un casque de taille moyenne.
frases.es: El vendedor también regala un casco de talla mediana.
frases.en: The seller also provides a medium-sized helmet.
